history: First 8-file structural screen run 39216613590 completed successfully before this endpoint was set.

existing_sources_boundary.lbbg: NOT_ADMITTED: 9 unique individuals with at least two eligible shared-cell flight days; frozen minimum 10. Never lower v1 denominator.
existing_sources_boundary.medgull: STRUCTURAL_POTENTIAL: 14 unique individuals across years. 2022 has 13, 2023 has 9, 2024 has 7, 2021 has 3 within-year candidates.

biological_question: Does an individual's centered GPS flight-altitude probability shape repeat across separate breeding-season days in a nonbat flying taxon when comparing identical supported 5-km x-y cells?
selection: 2022 primary chosen before altitude access because it has maximal predeclared x-y/time repeated-bird support (13 vs 3/9/7). No year reassignment following altitude inspection.
geometry_time: May-July UTC; same proxy speed 5-55m/s; exclude provider-marked outliers; exactly earliest flight-proxy event per 5min UTC bin; EPSG:32631, 5000m cells; sessions are UTC days.

altitude_qc.missing: drop earliest-selected 5min bin, never replace with later event in that bin
altitude_qc.source_outliers: exclude source-marked imported/manually-marked outliers if fields present
altitude_qc.rule: If less than 80 percent of the already selected 5min flight GPS events have finite in-bound native altitudes, primary altitude endpoint is unavailable rather than rescue via interpolation or wider bounds.
altitude_qc.measurement_caveat: session median subtraction eliminates additive height offsets, not tag-specific time-dependent variance or behavioural state mixing.

primary.centering: subtract day-wide median of valid prefiltered altitudes; day median is estimated using the target session and so the result describes held-out whole-session shape identity, not online prediction of absolute height.
primary.conditioning: same 5km cells for matched self-other train and heldout target events
primary.training: same individual other UTC breeding days vs all other conspecific birds in the same year on other UTC calendar days; both restricted to target-matched cells
primary.smoothed_frequency: Jeffreys 0.5 pseudocount per bin, declared for both models, no tuning.
primary.statistic: mean over scored days per bird, then mean over birds of per-fix log likelihood ratio log(P_self centered_alt_bin | cell) - log(P_others centered_alt_bin | cell)
primary.calibration: whole UTC-day session bird labels permuted within calendar-month strata, preserving individual label counts within each month; recompute full statistic and eligibility across permutations
primary.null_relative_gain: observed statistic minus mean of permuted full-statistic draws
primary.null_validity: At least 950/999 permutations must meet minimum 10 birds eligible; otherwise inference unavailable rather than reporting an optimistic subset-only p-value.
primary.success: minimum 10 eligible biological individuals after altitude QC, valid null >=950/999, one-sided p<0.05, null-relative estimate positive
primary.negative: valid null and p>=0.05 (or sign not positive); do not call failed/unstable data a biological negative
primary.if_unavailable: report separately if QC/overlap/power or null fails; no tuning or threshold relaxation.

secondary: absolute-altitude identity with identical bins, descriptive only because instrument zero offsets unresolved
2022 donor to 2023 and/or 2024 test within overlapping individuals, but no prospective claim if too few whole-subject repeats
barometric-height centered shape for events with native barometer data; independent-instrument corroboration only if >=80% complete under the same 5min bins and no posthoc retuning
source-level observed missingness and tag-specific measurement uncertainty are limitations, not sufficient for causal individual behavioural inference

claim_boundary.can_if_positive: One non-bat flying species has repeatable within-breeding-season centered flight-altitude organization at the declared x-y grain under the session exchangeability null.
claim_boundary.cannot: Universal cross-class/taxon ecological identity, biological personality, genotype, adaptive niche segregation, central-place causation, tag-error-free altitude truth, independent multi-species replication.
claim_boundary.scope: Two independent non-bat species with successful prior gates would be needed for taxonomic generality. LBBG remains structurally unadmitted.
